alt.en: Fact card: Gemini’s Recruit referral terms list a $50 reward each for referrer and referee in the United States, Hong Kong, and New Zealand after identity verification and a $100 qualifying trade

caption.en: Source: Gemini Referral Program Terms, last stated as updated January 20, 2026

alt.en: Fact card: the qualifying trade of at least $100 must be completed within 30 days of signup, and Gemini says the reward is paid 32 days after signup

caption.en: Source: Gemini Referral Program Terms, last stated as updated January 20, 2026
